a: Thomas Watson yali Mupuritaani Omungereza atakkiriza kkanisa ya gavumenti, eyali omusomesa n'oluvannyuma omukulembeze w'ekkanisa ya St Stephen's, Walbrook, wakati mu kibuga London, eyagobebwa mu buweereza bwe mu 1662. Ajjukirwa olw'ebiwandiiko bye eby'okwewaayo ebibuguma, ebimpi, era ebyeyoleka mu ngeri ey'ekitalo — omubuulizi eyasobola okuteeka mu sentensi emu ebisingawo ku ebyo abayivu abangi bye baateeka mu lupapula lulamba — era nga wayiseewo emyaka ebikumi bisatu n'ekitundu ali mu Bapuritaani abasomebwa ennyo okusinga abalala bonna.

q: Lwaki tumanyi bitono nnyo ku bulamu bwe?
a: Ebiwandiiko ku bulamu bwe bitono nnyo: yazaalibwa nga mu 1620 (ennaku eyo ya kulowoozebwa bulowoozebwa), ekifo kye yazaalirwamu tekikakafu, era ku bazadde be, ku buto bwe, ne ku kukyuka kwe, mu butuufu tetumanyiiko kintu. N'omwaka gw'okufa kwe gwamala ebbanga ddene nga gulowoozebwa bubi. Charles Spurgeon, eyakola ku bitabo bye nga wayiseewo emyaka ebikumi bibiri era n'anoonya ebikwata ku ye, yasalawo mu bwerufu nti ekiseera kye yazaalirwamu n'ekyo kye yafiiramu "tekyogeddwako wonna." Ekyasigalawo mu kifo ky'ebyo ddoboozi lye.

Alabikira mu maaso gaffe olubereberye mu Emmanuel College, Cambridge — ekifo ekikulu ekyakuza Obupuritaani — ng'aggya diguli ye esooka mu 1639 n'eyokubiri mu 1642, era n'aleka erinnya ery'omuyizi omunyiikivu ennyo. Ekyo kisaanidde okulowoozebwako: obumpi n'obwangu bw'ebiwandiiko bye eby'oluvannyuma, okuwulira nti akwogerako mu kifo ky'okukusomesa, tebyava ku birowoozo ebyangu wabula kwali kuyiga okwafunibwa n'okutegana naye ne kwambalibwa mu bwangu — Olwebbulaniya n'Oluyonaani n'ebiwandiiko bya bajjajja b'ekkanisa byasekulwa okutuusa lwe byafuluma nga Lungereza lwa bulijjo.

q: Obuweereza bwe e Walbrook bwali butya?
a: Mu 1646 Watson yajja e St Stephen's, Walbrook, olubereberye ng'omusomesa era oluvannyuma ng'omukulembeze w'ekkanisa, n'amalayo kumpi emyaka kkumi n'omukaaga mu kkanisa eyajjulanga bulijjo. Nga mu 1647 yawasa Abigail Beadle, muwala w'omuweereza Omupuritaani, era baazaala abaana abatali batono ku musanvu mu myaka kkumi n'esatu, bana ku bo ne bafa nga bakyali bato — omusajja eyawandiika n'ekisa ekingi bwe kityo ku kubonaabona okukolera awamu okuleeta obulungi yali aziise abaana be bana nga tannawandiika na lunyiriri lumu ku nsonga eyo.

q: Kiki ekyali eky'ekitalo mu kusaba kwe?
a: Abaamuwuliriza baawa okubuulira kwe omuwendo; ab'omulembe gwe baawa okusaba kwe omuwendo ogusingawo. Edmund Calamy yamuyita "akwatiikiridde mu kirabo ky'okusaba," era n'anyumya engeri Bishop Richardson, bwe yasanyukira okubuulira naye n'akwatibwako ennyo okusinga okusaba okwakuddirira, gye yawerekera Watson okutuuka ewaka amusabe ekiwandiiko kyakwo. "Ekyo kye siyinza kukuwa," Watson n'addamu, "kubanga sirina mpisa ya kuwandiika kusaba kwange; tekwali kutegekeddwa, wabula kwayogerwa, nga Katonda bwe yansobozesa, nga kuva mu bujjuvu bw'omutima gwange."

q: Endowooza ze ez'okuwagira kabaka zaamusasuza ki?
a: Watson yali Mupresbiteeriyaani era ng'awagira kabaka. Yawakanya okuttibwa kwa Charles I, era mu 1651 yayingizibwa mu lukwe lwa Christopher Love olw'okukomyawo Charles II, n'asibirwa ekyo awamu ne Love, eyatemwako omutwe. Watson yasaba okusaasirwa n'ateebwa mu 1652. Kye kimu ku bintu eby'ekyewuunyo ebisinga obukalu mu bulamu bwe nti omusajja eyeewaayo okusibwa olw'ensonga y'ab'olulyo lwa Stuart yandigobeddwa ku kituuti kye kabaka oyo yennyini gwe yabonaabona okukomyawo.

Act of Uniformity eya 1662 yasaba abaweereza okugoberera enkola Watson gye yali tasobola kukkiriza, era nga 24 August — ku lunaku lwa St Bartholomew — abaweereza nga enkumi bbiri baagobebwa mu mirimu gyabwe. Obwesigwa bwe tebwagasa kintu; nga Spurgeon bwe yakyogera, "naye ebyo byonna tebyagasa kintu, yali Mupuritaani." Okubuulira kwe okusatu okw'okusiibula kwasigalawo; ng'alaba ebigambo by'Etteeka nti abaweereza abaagobebwa balina okutwalibwa ng'abafu, yaleka abantu be ebiragiro amakumi abiri, ng'abakubiriza okubikuuma "ng'amayinja ag'omuwendo amangi mu kasanduuko k'ebifuba byammwe."

Bwe yamala okugobebwa, Watson yabuuliriranga buli we yasobolera obulungi — mu byagi, mu bifumbiro, mu bisenge eby'ebweru, ne mu bibira — eri obukuŋŋaana obutono obutakkirizibwa ng'ali wansi w'okutiisibwatiisibwa kw'okutanzibwa n'okusibwa. Omuliro Omunene ogwa 1666 bwe gwokya St Stephen's, ye n'abataakkiriza kkanisa ya gavumenti bannaawe baateekateeka ebisenge ebinene ku lw'abo bonna abaayagala okujja. Wansi wa Declaration of Indulgence eya 1672 yafuna olukusa olw'ekisenge ekinene ekya Crosby House n'abuulirayo emyaka mingi, era okuva mu 1675 n'agabana ekifo eky'okubuuliriramu ne Stephen Charnock okutuusa Charnock lwe yafa mu 1680.

Kyafulumizibwa mu 1663 nga "A Divine Cordial," omwaka ogwaddirira ogwo lwe yafiirwa buli kimu, era kwe kunnyonnyola kwe okwa Abaruumi 8:28 — okubudaabuda okutava mu kifo eky'emirembe, wabula okwa muweereza eyali yaakasirisibwa ng'agamba abantu be nti okulabirira kwa Katonda okwali kwakamenya obulamu bwe tekwali kwabuze mu bufuzi. Ebintu eby'obutwa, bwe yawandiika, bwe bigeraageranyizibwa n'obukugu bw'omukugu w'eddagala bikola eddagala ery'amaanyi ennyo; takusaba kwefuula nti ebintu ebyo si butwa, wabula weesige omukugu w'eddagala. "Oluvannyuma lw'eddagala erikaawa, Katonda awa sukaali."

q: Yafa atya, era omulimu gwe gwaba gutya?
a: Obulamu bwe bwe bwamuggwaamu amaanyi, yawummula n'agenda e Barnston mu Essex n'afiirayo mu bwangu mu 1686; ebyafaayo eby'obujjajja, newankubadde si bujulizi bwa maaso, bigamba nti yasangibwa ng'afudde mu kasenge ke ng'ali mu kusaba okw'ekyama — oluggi nga lumugaddwako ng'akyayogera, ng'ayogera ne Katonda oyo gwe yamala emyaka ana ng'atendera abalala. Omulimu gwe ogusinga obukulu gwafuluma oluvannyuma lw'okufa kwe: A Body of Practical Divinity, okubuulira kikumi mu nsanvu mu mukaaga ku Shorter Catechism, enjigiriza y'abantu ba bulijjo eyayigiriza abatasoma okulowooza.
